title: A pile, or a path through notes?
hook: Follow an original linked-note tree for one hop or three hops from the same starting note.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to separate collecting notes from traversing explicit links, without assuming those links are insightful

misconception: A growing note count alone establishes a connected and useful body of knowledge.
objective: Separate collecting notes from traversing explicit links, without assuming those links are insightful.
